sql_calls.sql:
SELECT 'daily_sales' t, min(date)::text mn, max(date)::text mx, count(*) n FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines', min(bill_ts)::text, max(bill_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'shelf_audits', min(audit_ts)::text, max(audit_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_book', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL SELECT 'forecasts', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL SELECT 'stock_counts', min(count_ts)::text, max(count_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL SELECT 'write_offs', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.write_offs
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_orders', min(created_ts)::text, max(created_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.store_orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'goods_receipts', min(received_ts)::text, max(received_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.goods_receipts;

SELECT 'daily_sales' src, SUM(units_sold) units, SUM(revenue_inr) revenue, COUNT(*) days
FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', SUM(qty), SUM(line_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id)
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT c.bill_id, c.kind, c.amount_inr, c.complaint_ts, c.resolution,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.bill_id=c.bill_id AND p.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') atta_lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.bill_id=c.bill_id) all_lines
FROM payments.customer_complaints c
WHERE c.bill_id IN (SELECT bill_id FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG')
ORDER BY c.complaint_ts;
SELECT sku, audit_ts, status FROM store.shelf_audits ORDER BY sku, audit_ts;

SELECT received_ts, grn_id, shipment_id, line, asn_sku, asn_units, sku_booked, units_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE (asn_sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' OR sku_booked='ATTA-WW-5KG')
ORDER BY received_ts;

SELECT d.date,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments p WHERE p.ts::date = d.date) bills_paid,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT l.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_ts::date = d.date) bills_with_tracked,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT l.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_ts::date = d.date AND l.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') bills_5kg,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT l.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_ts::date = d.date AND l.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) bills_other_atta,
       (SELECT sum(l.qty) FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_ts::date = d.date AND l.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') qty_5kg
FROM (SELECT generate_series('2026-06-01'::date,'2026-06-28'::date,'1 day')::date AS date) d
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT c.kind, count(*) n, min(c.complaint_ts)::text, max(c.complaint_ts)::text
FROM payments.customer_complaints c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT bill_ts, bill_id, line, qty, unit_price, line_amount
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts::date IN ('2026-06-11','2026-06-12','2026-06-23','2026-06-24','2026-06-25','2026-06-26')
ORDER BY bill_ts;

SELECT 'jun' scope,
       SUM(qty) units, COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) bills, ROUND(SUM(qty)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id),4) units_per_bill
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all', SUM(qty), COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id), ROUND(SUM(qty)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id),4)
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'jun_all_tracked', SUM(qty), COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id), ROUND(SUM(qty)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id),4)
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT date, sku, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-5KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')
  AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY date, sku;

SELECT sku,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS zero_sales_days,
       string_agg(date::text, ',' ORDER BY date) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS zero_days
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku;
